name: Omni plant-based senior dry dog food
note: Omni Senior (plant-based dry), label as fed: protein 26%, fat 7.5%, fibre 3%, 'vitamins and minerals' (ash) 7%, 341 kcal/100 g. Moisture NOT declared (9% assumed). CALCIUM, PHOSPHORUS, sodium, potassium, magnesium and omega-3 NOT declared - phosphorus is unknown, so recipes with this food can only show phosphorus as a minimum; ask Omni (woof@omni.pet) for Ca, P, Na, K before relying on it for a renal diet. Vitamins = ADDED amounts per kg (A 25,000 IU, D3 1,800 IU, E 245 IU); ingredients add more. Also adds taurine 2,000 mg, L-carnitine 1,000 mg, methionine 2,500 mg (urine-acidifying), Zn 120 mg (sulphate 70 + glycine chelate 50), Mn 25 mg, Fe 30 mg, Cu 10 mg, I 1.56 mg, Se 0.2 mg per kg. Composition: potato, pea starch, potato protein, brown rice, Hi-Pro soya, dried yeasts, oats, peas, pea protein, minerals, carrot, hydrolysed vegetables, lentils, rapeseed oil, sunflower oil, micro algae, blueberries, prebiotic FOS, cranberries, pumpkin. Marked complete food: undeclared Na/K/Mg and extended nutrients taken at the AAFCO minimum. Source: label values supplied by the user, Nov 2026.
